TO: All Parties of Record

FROM: Ron Olson
Commission Counsel

RE: PUC Docket No. 59475; SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349 - Joint Application
of Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Services
Corporation to Amend Their Certificates of Convenience and Necessity for the
Bell County East Switch to Big Hill Substation 765-kV Transmission Line
Project in Beil, Burnet, Concho, Coryell, Lampasas, Llano, Mason, McCulloch,
Menard, Milam, Mills, San Saba, Schleicher, Tom Green, and Williamson
Counties

DATE: 20 August 2026

Please be advised that the proposal for decision in the above styled docket issued on August
20, 2026, will be considered by commissioners at a future open meeting. A subsequent memo will
identify the specific open meeting date. The following schedule applies to this proceeding:

Deadline for Filing Exceptions
To Proposal for Decision: September 2, 2026

Deadline for Filing Replies to Exceptions: September 9, 2026

Exceptions to the proposal for decision and replies to exceptions must be filed with the
Commission and a copy must be served on all parties of record. The exceptions and replies must
follow the outline of the proposal for decision. However, parties may include additional sections
at the end. All filings must include both the SOAH docket number and the Commission docket
number. Parties should include all grounds, legal and factual, in the exceptions and replies as
appropriate; there is no provision for subsequent rounds of pleadings. LATE FILED
MATERIAL MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.

To coordinate the Commission’s consideration of this docket with its open meeting
schedule, the Commission requests that a SOAH exceptions letter be issued on or before
September 15, 2026.

ce: Linda Brite, Linda J. Burgess and Dee Marlo Chico, Administrative Law Judges
State Office of Administrative Hearings
